questions.prompt: What source categories should discovery prioritize for "every relevant AI feed"?
questions.description: Spec 003 already targets podcasts, newsletters, forums, docs, practitioners, conferences, governance, domain apps, geography, and emerging labs. Confirm breadth vs depth.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All listed categories plus blogs, research (arxiv/journals), org/lab announcements, GitHub releases, YouTube, Reddit/HN — continue spec 003's category shards and extend until saturation signals say stop.

questions.prompt: What is the catalog size target?
questions.description: Current: 319 sources in feeds.yaml, 262 enriched. Spec 003 planned +80–120 net. You asked for "every and all relevant" feeds.
questions.recommendedAnswer: No hard ceiling — discover until category saturation (spec 003 gap-matrix + orphan-matrix show diminishing returns). Minimum bar: complete spec 003's 80–120 verified candidates plus fix/enrich the full existing catalog.

options.label: No hard cap — stop at research saturation, not a number

questions.prompt: How should broken or unreachable feeds be handled?
questions.description: HTTP audit shows ~217/262 failures (many parse errors, 403/404). Strict policy was chosen in spec 003.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Strict: fix URL/replace feed where possible; remove if unrecoverable. Zero broken feeds at ship gate. Re-run HTTP validation after every integration wave.

options.label: Strict — fix or remove; 0 broken at done
Lenient — keep broken with notes for later
Quarantine broken feeds to a separate file

questions.prompt: What does "fully enriched" require for every catalog source?
questions.description: Schema requires id, title, source_type, topics. Enrichment pipeline can add tags, feed URL, meta scores, etc.
questions.recommendedAnswer: 100% of feeds.yaml sources present in feeds.enriched.yaml with required fields (id, title, source_type, topics) plus feed URL and tags where detectable. Regenerate SQLite cache. Counts must match.

options.label: Required schema fields (id, title, source_type, topics)

questions.prompt: Should we add verified / curation flags to new sources?
questions.description: Spec 003 policy: never author verified: true in feeds.yaml.
questions.recommendedAnswer: No — trusted-by-policy catalog; no verified flags in feeds.yaml; leave curation fields dormant.

options.label: Allow verified flags for high-confidence sources

questions.prompt: Which derivative data assets must be regenerated on completion?
questions.recommendedAnswer: All standard exports: feeds.enriched.yaml, OPML files, feeds.json, SQLite DB, and pass validate_data_assets.py 30/30.

questions.prompt: What is explicitly OUT of scope for this goal?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Real-time monitoring (spec 003-real-time-monitoring), web UI changes, new CLI features, verified-badge UX, and automated ongoing discovery cron — this goal is a one-time catalog saturation pass.

options.label: New CLI commands or enrichment logic

questions.prompt: What validation gates must pass for this goal to be DONE?
questions.recommendedAnswer: All CLI validation green, HTTP 0 broken, enriched count = feeds count, orphan topics ≤6, data assets 30/30.
